schema: Pine Compat FMZ 5006 archived v2 GBP account replay

model.venue: Archived Binance USD-M BTCUSDT ten-minute chart and independent ETHUSDT cross-asset run
model.account: Archived GBP currency, offline runtime default capital GBP 1,000,000, ten percent equity sizing, 0.001 base-asset lot step
model.fx_policy: Kraken completed daily USDTGBP close effective at following UTC midnight. Gross profit translates at the exit rate, and overlay fees translate at their respective fill rates.
model.trailing_rule: The exact archived v2 program runs. Its optional default-active trail entries omit the offset and yield only inert E_STRATEGY_EXIT_ENTRY diagnostics. A v2 branch-removal control and v5 namespace migration reproduce all original plots/settlement output apart from those diagnostics.
model.fee_overlay: 0.075 percent per side deducted from identical settled fills. Archived commission is zero. Drawdown is realized, with ending exposure marked separately.

coverage: Tested · Pine Compat native v2 GBP account
